headline: Congress named a federal courthouse and federal building in Fergus Falls, Minnesota, after former federal judge Edward J. Devitt.
what_it_does: This law officially designates the federal courthouse and federal building at 118 South Mill Street in Fergus Falls, Minnesota, as the "Edward J. Devitt United States Courthouse and Federal Building." It changes only the building's official name. It does not change how the building is used, who works there, or what services it offers.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 20, 2013.
